slides.body:
(1). Session Control:
The transition to the Extended session can be done from the Default one.
The transition to the Programming one can be done only from the Extended
The Default session can always be reached, no matter the current session
Garrett Internal
Part 1
1. Create a script that simulates the reading of a generic DID “AA AA” containing the vehicle's speed.
The response shall be positive and the content shall be 100 km/h
2. DID “BB BB” can be written only in the “Extended Session” (1).
Create a script to write its content equal to “XX XX”
3. Create a script to request the number of DTCs stored in the memory.
Let’s suppose that the response is positive and the result is: “4 DTCs present”
4. Create a script that sends a routine with this RID “CC CC”.
The response shall be negative because of a wrong length
5. Explain and give an example of a message with the “consecutive frames”
Pa rt 2
Explain step by step what is the meaning of each communication. Find and fix the mistakes, if any.
